'''Glaring Rakerbeast''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A rakerbeast variant featuring a different colored coat, shorter lifespan, but greater strength. Its eyes seem to glow like liquid fire.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Spotted Rakerbeast]], the Glaring Rakerbeast has similar appearance with its counterpart, but it doesn't make them less of the threat with most abilities remained with additions:

*Claws twice at front, dealing Physical damage.
*Claws once at front, followed by a tail swing that launch spines around, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps twice, dealing Physical damage on the landing spot, before launching a downwards claw followed by a tail swing around, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps forward before launching two claws at once, dealing Physical damage.
*Claws twice in quick succession, followed by an upwards claw after a short charge up, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Roars and deals continuous Physical damage before entering '''Enraged State''', which gives it ATK and following abilities:
**Leaps forward and deals Physical damage to Operators at front, before lifting its limbs and deals Physical damage ahead after charging up. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
**Claws twice, dealing Physical damage, then leaps backwards and claws an additional time after a short charging up, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.

Unlike Spotted Rakerbeast, the Glaring Rakerbeast will periodically become invisible for a short period if it's at low HP.
